caption_L1: Global number of green building certified projects constructed by Hochtief from 2008 to 2019 , by type of certification is a line plot. The y-axis plots Australia (Green Star) as a linear scale from 0 to 80. There is a linear scale of range 2008 to 2018 along the x-axis, labeled Year.
caption_L2L3: From 2008 and 2019 the number of green certified projects has increased in number every year. Every 4 years the number of green projects doubles with the years after 2016 being the exception. After the year 2016 the number increased more than any other year. The years 2018 to 2019 showed no increase and no loss.
